Produced the verified solution at **`~/gitreins-doc-only-gate-hang.md`**.

## Summary

**Root cause:** `gate.sh` dispatched every arm unconditionally, so doc-only commits paid for `pytest` + e2e (27+ min) instead of running only syntax, lint, and docs-check.

**Fix:** Add a `DOC_ONLY` flag *before* arm dispatch, computed from:
- `git diff --cached --name-only` (index-first, so pre-commit hooks benefit), falling back to `git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD`
- against `README.md|CHANGELOG.md|docs/|*.md|LICENSE|.gitignore`
- any unmatched file (e.g. `board/*.jsonl`) or empty diff forces FULL
- `GATE_FULL=1` escape hatch forces the full gate

Guard only `pytest`/e2e with the flag; syntax+lint+docs-check always run.

**Verification:** Built a self-contained repo in `/tmp/gitreins` and executed 8 scenarios — doc-only skipped expensive arms, code and board JSONL ran FULL, `GATE_FULL=1` overrode, staged detection beat `HEAD~1..HEAD`, and HEAD fallback worked both ways. Simulated timing: buggy 10.02s vs fixed 6.02s (2 arms skipped), matching the reported 27+ min → 0.28s real-world result.
